name: Wheeler Metals
old_description: Established in 1968, Wheeler Metals has been providing quality service and products to our customers for over 55 years.
about:
Wheeler Metals was founded in 1968 in Springfield, Missouri. The company maintains three locations: its original Springfield headquarters, a branch in Muskogee, Oklahoma, and another in Rogers, Arkansas. Ownership details are not publicly disclosed.

The company operates a 30,000-square-foot facility designed for metal roofing and trim production, and distributes a broad line of structural steel products including angle iron, beam, channel, plate, sheet, tubing, and pipe. It also stocks aluminum, rebar, bar grating, and expanded metal, along with trailer components, winches, welding equipment, air compressors, power tools, and farm supplies. An online design tool allows customers to configure metal buildings and request custom quotes.

Wheeler Metals serves construction contractors, agricultural operators, trailer manufacturers, and welding shops. Its inventory targets builders needing structural metal and roofing, farmers requiring feeders, gates, and cattle guards, and fabricators sourcing raw steel and aluminum shapes.

The company emphasizes its large on-hand inventory and regional presence as key advantages, promoting monthly discounts on building materials, tools, and equipment.
